fields.System.Title: INB-403 — Report on dock-to-stock time
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want to see how long goods take from arrival to being stored,
so that I can tell whether stock is becoming sellable fast enough.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a date range, then I get average and 95th-percentile time from receipt
  • confirmation to putaway confirmation.
  • - Given the report, then it breaks down by supplier, by zone, and by hour of day.
  • - Given receipts still awaiting putaway, then they are shown as in-progress with their
  • current age.
  • - Given the target of four hours, then the proportion breaching it is shown.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound |
| Tables | receipt, putaway_task |
| Risks | Live aggregate query degrading over time ([doc 08 §3](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
